articles.summary: Unsiloed AI has secured $7.5 million in a funding round led by Felicis to develop technology that prepares corporate documents for use by AI agents. articles.title: Circle turns to DBS as banks build rival digital payment systems across Asia
articles.summary: Circle has partnered with Singapore-based DBS Bank to facilitate liquidity management and settlement services for its stablecoin operations in Asia. This strategic move arrives as several major financial institutions in the region begin developing their own proprietary digital payment infrastructures. The collaboration aims to streamline transaction processes for users while strengthening Circle's presence in the evolving Asian digital asset market.

articles.title: They migrated to New York for work. Now they’re fighting to climate-proof it.
articles.summary: Immigrant laborers who originally moved to New York City for employment are now playing a significant role in efforts to enhance the city's climate resilience. These workers are leading various infrastructure projects designed to protect urban areas from environmental threats and extreme weather events.

articles.title: GTA 6 Hits 99 on Metacritic, Crowned Best Game Ever in Wave of Rave Reviews
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has reached a record-breaking Metacritic score of 99, making it the highest-rated title in the platform's history. This achievement places the Rockstar Games production ahead of the long-standing top position previously held by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

articles.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need

articles.title: Blaming Anthropic’s IPO for bitcoin’s slide is 'easy to believe,' but flawed, analysts say
articles.summary: Market analysts are challenging the theory that a recent dip in bitcoin's value was triggered by events surrounding Anthropic. Although the explanation has become a popular talking point, experts suggest it is a flawed conclusion that ignores more impactful financial factors. They instead attribute the price volatility to broader market trends rather than specific developments in the AI sector.

articles.title: Terac: AML and Compliance Experts: AI Training Tasks
articles.summary: Terac is recruiting anti-money laundering and compliance professionals to participate in a remote project aimed at training artificial intelligence for financial regulatory tasks. Participants will contribute to the development of automated systems by designing complex scenarios for transaction monitoring and sanctions screening. The selection process includes video interviews and a short trial period to assess expertise in handling intricate compliance frameworks.

articles.title: What Congress’ bill to speed up energy projects would mean for you
articles.summary: New federal legislation aims to accelerate the development of energy infrastructure by streamlining the permitting process and setting stricter deadlines for environmental reviews. The bill seeks to speed up the construction of both renewable energy projects and traditional power lines to modernize the nation's electrical grid. These changes are intended to reduce long-standing bureaucratic delays that currently stall large-scale energy deployments.

articles.title: Why Bangladesh must pivot to renewable energy now
articles.summary: Bangladesh is currently facing a significant energy crisis driven by an over-reliance on imported fossil fuels, which account for more than 60 percent of its energy supply. These shortages are impacting critical sectors such as manufacturing and agriculture while also straining the country's foreign currency reserves. Experts suggest that pivoting toward renewable energy is necessary to address these systemic vulnerabilities and ensure long-term economic stability.

articles.title: 20 Years Later, Paramount's Serial Killer Series Officially Breaks a Weird TV Record
articles.summary: Actor Gabriel Luna recently discussed his preparation for the upcoming prequel *Dexter: Original Sin*, which revisits the franchise twenty years after its initial debut. The series sets a unique television record for longevity, marking the first time a crime drama has returned with a prequel this long after its premiere. Luna shared his perspective on the filming process and the mental challenges of joining the established universe.

articles.title: China dominates battery graphite, but this startup could break the monopoly
articles.summary: Startup Molten Industries has opened a new production facility in Oakland intended to compete with China’s established control over the graphite industry. The company seeks to provide a domestic alternative for the battery material, which is currently sourced almost exclusively from Chinese suppliers.
